block.title: External Assistants (MCP)
block.name: nudge_mcp_container
block.div: API keys made for assistants before the sign-in with OAuth stop working on . Connect each assistant with OAuth instead: add the address of this server as a connector in the assistant and sign in to Odoo (How to Connect an Assistant, below). Then delete the old keys in each person's Account Security.

setting.help: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and other assistants that speak MCP can use the tools of Nudge, as the person who signed them in: with that person's rights, record rules and companies. Each person of the group External Assistant signs their assistant in. Everything they do is kept in What Nudge Did.

div.div: The tools that build or run code are never offered. A change is never made at once: the assistant gets a token, the person is asked in Odoo (Nudge, Assistant Approvals) and sees what will change, and the assistant can confirm with the token only after the person has approved it there.

setting.help: Changes from assistants also need the group Agent User for the person and Agent Mode above. Set for the company in use.

setting.invisible: not nudge_mcp_enabled or nudge_mcp_exposure == 'read' or not nudge_mcp_allow_writes
setting.help: Off by default: every change waits for the person's yes in Odoo. List here only changes that are easy to take back, per change, model and assistant. Posting, paying, confirming, users and rights always wait.
Assistants connect with the address of the server: the person signs in to Odoo and allows them. Keys made before still work (legacy).
With Private Mode on, assistants are refused unless they run on your own server.
